answer: A farm that floods the queue early hence gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. Because the delta ordering is published with the harbor batch, the signal audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 51% of the queue is processed in arrival order. A 104 account operation therefore ties up 21 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
